root_cause: The SEO loop correctly required repository, canonical-owner and delivery-lineage inspection, but could incorrectly convert that prerequisite into an advice-only stop condition.
The execution contract did not explicitly require inspection and candidate creation to occur in the same autonomous run when commercial evidence was sufficient.

evidence.observed_failure: A commercially evidenced SEO run ended by saying no GitHub candidate was created because repository state, canonical URL owner and delivery lineage first needed inspection.

prevention: Inspection is mandatory work inside the execution run, never a terminal excuse.
When evidence is sufficient, inspect main, owner maps, target source, open lineages and delivery hygiene, then autonomously implement through one compatible candidate lineage.
Ask the operator only for genuine authority, credential, safety/legal or irreducible business-choice blockers.
Transient tool and CI failures enter recovery rather than advice-only output.
Insufficient evidence terminates only as REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE with the exact missing evidence persisted.
